/* ===== SCROLL LOCK — while any popup / modal / drawer is open, the page
   behind it must not move a pixel. Reference-counted so stacked surfaces
   (menu → full view, wheel detail → full view, view → call sheet) nest
   safely: the page unlocks only when the LAST surface closes. Uses the
   fixed-body technique because overflow:hidden alone does not stop iOS
   Safari from scrolling the page behind an open sheet; unlocking
   restores the exact scroll position the user left. ===== */
var __lockCount=0,__lockY=0;
function lockScroll(){
  if(__lockCount===0){
    __lockY=window.scrollY||0;
    var b=document.body.style;
    b.overflow='hidden';b.position='fixed';b.top=(-__lockY)+'px';b.left='0';b.right='0';b.width='100%';
  }
  __lockCount++;
}
function unlockScroll(){
  if(__lockCount>0)__lockCount--;
  if(__lockCount!==0)return;
  var b=document.body.style;
  b.overflow='';b.position='';b.top='';b.left='';b.right='';b.width='';
  window.scrollTo(0,__lockY);
}

function closeSheet(){if(!modal.classList.contains('open'))return;modal.classList.remove('open');unlockScroll();}
modal.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===modal)closeSheet()});

function bkBookHTML(){
  const es=LANG==='es',t=bkStrings(es),v=BK.vals;
  if(BK.done)return bkDoneHTML();
  const selN=BK.sel.size;
  const selTxt=selN===0?t.selNone:(selN===1?t.selOne:t.selMany(selN));
  /* booking hub wheel — node slots + spokes computed ONCE here, in percent
     space (same tuned superellipse slot angles as the old home wheel), and
     baked into the markup: the ring renders correctly on first paint at
     any width, with no JS sizing pass that could ever collapse it */
  const wkPos=[-90,-54,-10,22,76,104,158,190,234].map(d=>{const a=d*Math.PI/180,c=Math.cos(a),s=Math.sin(a);return{x:(50+37.5*Math.sign(c)*Math.pow(Math.abs(c),.625)).toFixed(1),y:(50+37*Math.sign(s)*Math.pow(Math.abs(s),.625)).toFixed(1)};});
  const wkLabels=es?BK_WEB_LABELS_ES:BK_WEB_LABELS_EN;
  const wkNodes=SERVICES.map((sv,i)=>`<button type="button" class="wnode${BK.sel.has(i)?' sel':''}" data-bkwheel="${i}" aria-pressed="${BK.sel.has(i)?'true':'false'}" aria-label="${bkEsc(bkSvcName(i,es))}" style="left:${wkPos[i].x}%;top:${wkPos[i].y}%"><span class="wn-dot"><span class="wn-glow" style="animation-delay:-${(i*0.47).toFixed(2)}s"></span>${typeof ICONS!=='undefined'&&ICONS[sv.icon]?ICONS[sv.icon]:''}<span class="wn-num">0${i+1}</span><span class="wn-check" aria-hidden="true">✓</span></span><span class="wn-label">${bkEsc(wkLabels[i])}</span></button>`).join('');
  const wkLines=wkPos.map((p,i)=>`<line class="bk-spoke${BK.sel.has(i)?' on':''}" x1="50" y1="50" x2="${p.x}" y2="${(p.y-4).toFixed(1)}"/>`).join('');
  const typeOpts=(es?BK_TYPES_ES:BK_TYPES_EN).map((x,i)=>`<option value="${bkEsc(BK_TYPES_EN[i])}"${v.etype===BK_TYPES_EN[i]?' selected':''}>${bkEsc(x)}</option>`).join('');
  const guestOpts=(es?BK_GUESTS_ES:BK_GUESTS_EN).map((x,i)=>`<option value="${bkEsc(BK_GUESTS_EN[i])}"${(v.guests||BK_GUESTS_EN[0])===BK_GUESTS_EN[i]?' selected':''}>${bkEsc(x)}</option>`).join('');
  const prefOpts=(es?BK_PREF_ES:BK_PREF_EN).map((x,i)=>`<option value="${bkEsc(BK_PREF_EN[i])}"${(v.pref||BK_PREF_EN[0])===BK_PREF_EN[i]?' selected':''}>${bkEsc(x)}</option>`).join('');
  return `<div class="bk-flow"><div class="bk-contact"><button class="btn btn-gold" data-call type="button">${t.call}</button><a class="btn btn-ghost" href="mailto:${EMAIL}">${t.emailBtn}</a></div>
  <form class="book bk-form" id="bookForm" data-bk="v2" novalidate style="margin-top:18px">
    <p class="bk-sec"><span class="bk-n">01</span>${t.s1}</p>
    <p class="bk-hint">${t.s1hint}</p>
    <div class="svcweb bk-web" id="bkWeb" role="group" aria-label="${bkEsc(t.s1)}">
      <svg class="web-lines" id="bkWebLines" viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><ellipse class="bk-ring-o" cx="50" cy="50" rx="37.5" ry="37"/><ellipse class="bk-ring-i" cx="50" cy="50" rx="23.2" ry="22.9"/><rect class="bk-ring-s" x="26.8" y="27.1" width="46.4" height="45.8"/>${wkLines}</svg>
      <div class="web-hub" aria-hidden="true"><span class="wh-name">Premiere <span>Vibes</span></span><span class="wh-sub" id="bkHubCount">0 / 9</span></div>
      <div class="web-nodes" id="bkWebNodes">${wkNodes}</div>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="bk-svc bk-lvl${BK.sel.has(BK_LVL_IDX)?' on':''}" data-bksvc="${BK_LVL_IDX}" aria-pressed="${BK.sel.has(BK_LVL_IDX)?'true':'false'}"><span class="bk-box" aria-hidden="true">✓</span><span class="bk-lvlmain"><span class="bk-lvlname">${bkEsc(bkSvcName(BK_LVL_IDX,es))}</span><span class="bk-sub">${t.lvlSub}</span></span></button>
    <div class="bk-svcfoot"><span class="bk-selcount${selN?' has':''}" id="bkSelCount" aria-live="polite">${selTxt}</span><span><button type="button" class="bk-mini" id="bkAll">${t.all}</button><button type="button" class="bk-mini" id="bkClear">${t.clear}</button></span></div>
    <p class="bk-sec"><span class="bk-n">02</span>${t.s2}</p>
    <label class="bk-lab">${t.name} <span class="req">*</span><input name="bkname" id="bkName" autocomplete="name" value="${bkEsc(v.name||'')}" placeholder="Jane Smith"/></label>
    <div class="frow">
      <label class="bk-lab">${t.phone}<input type="tel" name="bkphone" id="bkPhone" autocomplete="tel" inputmode="tel" value="${bkEsc(v.phone||'')}"/></label>
      <label class="bk-lab">${t.email}<input type="email" name="bkemail" id="bkEmail" autocomplete="email" inputmode="email" value="${bkEsc(v.email||'')}"/></label>
    </div>
    <p class="bk-hint" style="margin-top:8px">${t.contactReq}</p>
    <label class="bk-lab">${t.pref}<select name="bkpref" id="bkPref">${prefOpts}</select></label>
    <p class="bk-sec"><span class="bk-n">03</span>${t.s3}</p>
    <label class="bk-lab">${t.inq} <span class="opt">(${t.optional})</span><input name="bkinq" id="bkInq" value="${bkEsc(v.inq||'')}" placeholder="${bkEsc(t.inqPh)}"/></label>
    <div class="frow">
      <label class="bk-lab">${t.etype} <span class="opt">(${t.optional})</span><select name="bketype" id="bkEtype"><option value="">${t.etypeFirst}</option>${typeOpts}</select></label>
      <label class="bk-lab">${t.date} <span class="opt">(${t.optional})</span><input type="date" name="bkdate" id="bkDate" value="${bkEsc(v.date||'')}"/></label>
    </div>
    <div class="frow">
      <label class="bk-lab">${t.loc} <span class="opt">(${t.optional})</span><input name="bkloc" id="bkLoc" value="${bkEsc(v.loc||'')}" placeholder="${bkEsc(t.locPh)}"/></label>
      <label class="bk-lab">${t.guests} <span class="opt">(${t.optional})</span><select name="bkguests" id="bkGuests">${guestOpts}</select></label>
    </div>
    <label class="bk-lab">${t.desc} <span class="opt">(${t.optional})</span><textarea name="bkdesc" id="bkDesc" rows="4" placeholder="${bkEsc(t.descPh)}">${bkEsc(v.desc||'')}</textarea></label>
    <div class="bk-err" id="bkErr" role="alert"></div>
    <button class="btn btn-pink bk-submit" type="submit">${t.submit}</button>
    <p class="bk-fine">${t.fine}</p>
  </form></div>`;
}
function bkDoneHTML(){
  const es=LANG==='es',t=bkStrings(es),d=BK.done;if(!d)return '';
  const svcNames=(d.servicesIdx&&d.servicesIdx.length)?d.servicesIdx.map(i=>bkSvcName(i,es)):d.services;
  const svcChips=svcNames.length?svcNames.map(s=>`<span class="bk-chip">${bkEsc(s)}</span>`).join(''):bkEsc(t.noneSel);
  const row=(k,val,raw)=>val?`<div class="bk-row"><span class="bk-k">${k}</span><span class="bk-v">${raw?val:bkEsc(val)}</span></div>`:'';
  const subj=encodeURIComponent((es?'Consulta de evento — ':'Event Inquiry — ')+(d.inq||d.etype||'Premiere Vibes')+' ('+d.name+')');
  const lines=[[t.sumName,d.name],[t.sumPhone,d.phone],[t.sumEmail,d.email],[t.sumPref,d.pref],[t.sumInq,d.inq],[t.sumType,d.etype],[t.sumDate,d.date],[t.sumLoc,d.loc],[t.sumGuests,d.guests],[t.sumSvc,svcNames.join(', ')],[t.sumDesc,d.desc]].filter(x=>x[1]).map(x=>x[0]+': '+x[1]).join('\n');
  const mail=`mailto:${EMAIL}?subject=${subj}&body=${encodeURIComponent(lines)}`;
  return `<div class="bk-done bk-flow" id="bkDone">
    <div class="bk-tick" aria-hidden="true">✓</div>
    <h3>${t.doneH}</h3><p class="bk-dsub">${t.doneSub}</p>
    <div class="bk-sum">
      <div class="bk-row"><span class="bk-k">${t.sumSvc}</span><span class="bk-v">${svcChips}</span></div>
      ${row(t.sumName,d.name)}${row(t.sumPhone,d.phone)}${row(t.sumEmail,d.email)}${row(t.sumPref,d.pref)}${row(t.sumInq,d.inq)}${row(t.sumType,d.etype)}${row(t.sumDate,d.date)}${row(t.sumLoc,d.loc)}${row(t.sumGuests,d.guests)}${row(t.sumDesc,d.desc)}
    </div>
    <div class="bk-actions">
      <a class="btn btn-gold" href="${mail}">${t.emailThis}</a>
      <button class="btn btn-pink" data-call type="button">${t.callNow}</button>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="bkAgain" type="button">${t.again}</button>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="bkHome" type="button">${t.back}</button>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function wireBook(){
  const form=document.getElementById('bookForm');
  const doneBox=document.getElementById('bkDone');
  if(doneBox){
    doneBox.querySelectorAll('[data-call]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',callSheet));
    const ag=document.getElementById('bkAgain');if(ag)ag.addEventListener('click',()=>{BK.done=null;BK.sel.clear();BK.vals={};openView('book');});
    const hm=document.getElementById('bkHome');if(hm)hm.addEventListener('click',()=>{BK.done=null;closeView();});
    return;
  }
  if(!form)return;
  const es=LANG==='es',t=bkStrings(es);
  if(typeof window.__bkPre==='number'&&window.__bkPre>=0&&window.__bkPre<9){BK.sel.add(window.__bkPre);window.__bkPre=null;
    form.querySelectorAll('[data-bksvc]').forEach(b=>{const i=+b.dataset.bksvc,on=BK.sel.has(i);b.classList.toggle('on',on);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false');});}
  const countEl=document.getElementById('bkSelCount');
  function syncCount(){const n=BK.sel.size;if(countEl){countEl.textContent=n===0?t.selNone:(n===1?t.selOne:t.selMany(n));countEl.classList.toggle('has',n>0);}}
  syncCount();
  /* --- BOOKING WHEEL — the EVENT SERVICES hub lives here now as the
     services step (Taylor's order: the hub replaces the 01–09 list on Book
     Now). The ring geometry is baked into the markup (percent slots), so
     this wiring only handles selection: same function as the dashboard
     pills — tap a node to SELECT it, tap again to deselect, as many at
     once as you want. No department preview opens from the booking hub.
     State is BK.sel, the exact set the form already submits, so the
     confirmation and the Owner Dashboard lead carry the picked services. --- */
  let syncBkWheel=null;
  (function wireBkWheel(){
    const box=document.getElementById('bkWebNodes');
    if(!box)return;
    const hubCount=document.getElementById('bkHubCount');
    const nodes=[...box.querySelectorAll('[data-bkwheel]')];
    const spokes=[...document.querySelectorAll('#bkWebLines .bk-spoke')];
    function sync(){
      nodes.forEach((n,j)=>{const on=BK.sel.has(j);n.classList.toggle('sel',on);n.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false');if(spokes[j])spokes[j].classList.toggle('on',on);});
      if(hubCount)hubCount.textContent=[...BK.sel].filter(i=>i<9).length+' / 9';
    }
    syncBkWheel=sync;
    nodes.forEach((b,idx)=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(BK.sel.has(idx))BK.sel.delete(idx);else BK.sel.add(idx);
      try{if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(10);}catch(e){}
      sync();syncCount();
    }));
    function setRoving(i){nodes.forEach((n,j)=>{n.tabIndex=j===i?0:-1;});}
    nodes.forEach((n,j)=>{n.tabIndex=j===0?0:-1;});
    box.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
      const cur=document.activeElement;
      if(!cur||!cur.dataset||typeof cur.dataset.bkwheel==='undefined')return;
      const idx=parseInt(cur.dataset.bkwheel,10);if(isNaN(idx))return;
      let n=null;
      if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='ArrowDown')n=(idx+1)%9;
      else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='ArrowUp')n=(idx+8)%9;
      else if(e.key==='Home')n=0;
      else if(e.key==='End')n=8;
      if(n!==null){e.preventDefault();setRoving(n);nodes[n].focus();}
    });
    sync();
  })();
  form.querySelectorAll('[data-bksvc]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const i=+b.dataset.bksvc;
    if(BK.sel.has(i))BK.sel.delete(i);else BK.sel.add(i);
    const on=BK.sel.has(i);b.classList.toggle('on',on);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false');syncCount();
  }));
  const allB=document.getElementById('bkAll'),clrB=document.getElementById('bkClear');
  if(allB)allB.addEventListener('click',()=>{for(let i=0;i<9;i++)BK.sel.add(i);form.querySelectorAll('[data-bksvc]').forEach(b=>{const on=BK.sel.has(+b.dataset.bksvc);b.classList.toggle('on',on);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false');});if(syncBkWheel)syncBkWheel();syncCount();});
  if(clrB)clrB.addEventListener('click',()=>{BK.sel.clear();form.querySelectorAll('[data-bksvc]').forEach(b=>{b.classList.remove('on');b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');});if(syncBkWheel)syncBkWheel();syncCount();});
  const map={bkName:'name',bkPhone:'phone',bkEmail:'email',bkPref:'pref',bkInq:'inq',bkEtype:'etype',bkDate:'date',bkLoc:'loc',bkGuests:'guests',bkDesc:'desc'};
  Object.keys(map).forEach(id=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.addEventListener('input',()=>{BK.vals[map[id]]=el.value;el.classList.remove('bk-invalid');});});
  form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const g=id=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);return el?el.value.trim():'';};
    const name=g('bkName'),phone=g('bkPhone'),email=g('bkEmail');
    const errs=[];
    const nameEl=document.getElementById('bkName'),phEl=document.getElementById('bkPhone'),emEl=document.getElementById('bkEmail');
    [nameEl,phEl,emEl].forEach(el=>el&&el.classList.remove('bk-invalid'));
    if(name.length<2){errs.push(t.errName);if(nameEl){nameEl.classList.add('bk-invalid');}}
    if(!phone&&!email){errs.push(t.errContact);if(phEl)phEl.classList.add('bk-invalid');if(emEl)emEl.classList.add('bk-invalid');}
    if(email&&!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(email)){errs.push(t.errEmail);if(emEl)emEl.classList.add('bk-invalid');}
    if(phone&&phone.replace(/\D/g,'').length<7){errs.push(t.errPhone);if(phEl)phEl.classList.add('bk-invalid');}
    const errBox=document.getElementById('bkErr');
    if(errs.length){if(errBox){errBox.innerHTML=errs.map(x=>bkEsc(x)).join('<br/>');errBox.classList.add('show');errBox.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}const bad=form.querySelector('.bk-invalid');if(bad)bad.focus({preventScroll:true});return;}
    if(errBox)errBox.classList.remove('show');
    const selIdx=[...BK.sel].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    const services=selIdx.map(i=>bkSvcName(i,es));
    const canon={pref:g('bkPref'),etype:g('bkEtype'),guests:g('bkGuests')};
    const loc1=(canonVal,listEN,listES)=>{const ix=listEN.indexOf(canonVal);return ix<0?canonVal:(es?listES[ix]:listEN[ix]);};
    const d={name:name,phone:phone,email:email,pref:loc1(canon.pref,BK_PREF_EN,BK_PREF_ES),inq:g('bkInq'),etype:loc1(canon.etype,BK_TYPES_EN,BK_TYPES_ES),date:g('bkDate'),loc:g('bkLoc'),guests:loc1(canon.guests,BK_GUESTS_EN,BK_GUESTS_ES),desc:g('bkDesc'),services:services,servicesIdx:selIdx};
    BK.done=d;BK.vals={name:name,phone:phone,email:email,pref:canon.pref,inq:d.inq,etype:canon.etype,date:d.date,loc:d.loc,guests:canon.guests,desc:d.desc};
    LEADS.unshift({name:name,type:d.etype||d.inq||(es?'Consulta de evento':'Event inquiry'),msg:d.desc||d.inq||services.join(', '),services:services,phone:phone,email:email,date:d.date,loc:d.loc,guests:d.guests,inq:d.inq,pref:d.pref,when:new Date().toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'})});
    renderPills();
    vsBody.innerHTML=viewBodyHTML('book');wireBook();
    viewSheet.scrollTop=0;
    toast(t.toast);
  });
}
function viewBodyHTML(id){
  const es=LANG==='es';
  if(id==='services'){
    return `<p class="lead">${es?'Nueve departamentos, un solo equipo. Todo se produce en casa.':'Nine departments, one team. Everything is produced in-house.'}</p>`+
    SERVICES.map((sv,i)=>`<div class="v-item"><span class="v-num">0${i+1}</span><h3>${sv.name}</h3><p>${es&&SVC_ES[i]?SVC_ES[i]:sv.short}</p><ul>${sv.detail.map(d=>`<li>${d}</li>`).join('')}</ul></div>`).join('')+
    `<div class="v-ctas"><button class="btn btn-pink" data-goview="book">${es?'Reservar con un servicio →':'Book with a service →'}</button></div>`;
  }
  if(id==='work'){
    return `<p class="lead">${es?'Producciones recientes verificadas de premierevibes.com — solo fotos reales de Premiere Vibes.':'Verified recent productions from premierevibes.com — real Premiere Vibes photos only.'}</p>
    <figure class="v-img" style="margin-top:14px"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
